notes.title: We saved the best for last!
notes.content:
EnsenaSoft is a Mexican company and we are excited to share a piece of Mexico with you. With today's new release, you can now enjoy lots of lively Mexican music in our colorful new Mexican "Day of the Dead" theme!  

With the recently added Western theme, this now wraps up what we plan to do with VR Theme Park Rides.  We hope you all enjoy the 5 diffrent themes and all of the music too.

I would only expect a future update if we need to do so for maintenance or new device support.

notes.title: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas...
notes.content:
Everywhere you go; Take a look at VR Theme Park Rides, glistening once again.  With candy canes and silver lanes aglow. 

Yes!  We always have enjoyed creating Christmas themes in some of our most popular games.  So we could not resist adding in a whole Christmas themed park!  I really think this is our best theme yet.  

Along with the original American Classic and the African Safari, you can now enjoy the park with 3 completely different themes.  

Enjoy,
EnsenaSoft

notes.title: New & Improved Theme Park + Brand New Theme !
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We are proud to present a major update to our VR Theme Park Rides game:

- Our original park has received a major makeover and is now called the Classic Americana Park

- The Roller Coaster ride has been redone to offer exciting new thrills and chills

- A NEW African Safari Theme Park is now included with the game! Double the fun!

Enjoy!
